newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Islamist-led govt survives censure scare.
newsitem.headline: Turk Islamist-led govt survives censure scare.

text.p: Turkey's parliament on Tuesday voted to drop a censure motion filed against Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan and his cabinet by the secularist opposition, speaker Mustafa Kalemli said.
MPs voted 271 against 265 to drop the motion, which criticises the Islamist-conservative government for straying from the country's 73-year-old secularist path.
"Therefore the debate on the censure motion has been rejected," Kalemli told parliament.
The government has been embroiled in a row with the powerful, secularist military -- which was strongly backed by the mainstream media -- over Islamist activism.
Despite the victory it faces an uncertain future, with dissident government MPs trying to craft an Islamist-free coalition formula with the fractious opposition.
